title: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a user who holds the "ess_user" Splunk Enterprise Security role…
description: In Splunk Enterprise Security versions below 8.7.0, a vulnerability exists where a user with the "ess_user" role can run a search that injects attacker-controlled Search Processing Language (SPL) text into the Search Audit dashboard. When another user with access to this dashboard selects the affected search, the attacker-controlled SPL commands execute with the selecting user's permissions. This flaw arises because the Search Audit dashboard does not properly escape logged search text before using it in drilldown searches.
